Cost: 250eb (Expensive) for 1
Stack: 1

With an Action and 1 minute, turns one non-hovering, non-Smart grenade into a Homing grenade (uses up the kit). Homing grenades can't go in Grenade Launchers. Thrown, it hovers over its landing square and spends the Round scanning a 14x14m/yds (7x7 square) area, through smoke, glass, and darkness but not roofs, for the biggest threat to you, friend or foe. Next Round it flies at that target over any Cover and detonates; dodging it takes DV17 Evasion. While hovering it can be hit with an Aimed Shot, which makes it burst harmlessly.

Foundry notes:

  • Not loadable ammo: an adapter you apply to other rounds or grenades.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Ammunition).
